verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe fetched a public, keyless OpenAPI document at /api/v3/openapi (HTTP 200, 681K chars, 'openapi' key and endpoint definitions present). That same URL serves the documented API content on auth, rate limits, and idempotency, so the spec is first-party and machine-readable. Missing for 10: independent community corroboration of the spec's completeness and accuracy, and documentation of spec versioning or alternate formats (e.g. YAML/JSON download options).
